newsitem.title: SPAIN: Demand for Telefonica huge on day one.
newsitem.headline: Demand for Telefonica huge on day one.

text.p: Demand for Telefonica de Espana shares on the first day of the sale of Spain's remaining 20.9 percent stake reached nearly 46 million shares in the retail tranche, a spokesman said on Tuesday.

Subscriptions accounted for nearly 58.4 percent of the total shares initially allotted for the retail tranche, with a value of 155.21 billion pesetas according to Monday's close. The number of people requesting shares was 81,513, he said.
Telefonica said the initial offering size was of 171 million shares, of which 50 percent would be offered domestically. The retail tranche is 58.4 percent
Shares in Telefonica ended Monday, the first day of the retail subscription period, wiith a rise of 10 pesetas to 3,385, down from a high of 3,420.
